# Code of conduct

reelplanner follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
In short, for everyone in the issues, pull requests, reviews and discussions here:

- Be kind and assume good faith. Critique the plan, the code or the video, not the person.
- Welcome newcomers, and questions that seem basic: the docs are meant to answer them, and a question
  they don't answer is a bug in the docs.
- No harassment, insults, personal attacks, or unwanted sexual attention, in public or in private.
- Don't publish anyone's private information, and don't put other people's code or review data in an
  issue without their say.

## If something happens

Tell the maintainers privately: open a private report from the repository's **Security** tab
(**Report a vulnerability**, which only the maintainers can read) and say it is a conduct report, or
write to the owner through the contact on their GitHub profile ([ncrispino](https://github.com/ncrispino)).
The maintainers will keep your report confidential, reply, and act as the Covenant's enforcement
guidelines say: a correction, a warning, a temporary ban, or a permanent one.
